source.title: 2026 UDK Expert List: Busts
source.author: Fantasy Footballers
source.summary: Eleven price-sensitive fades covering role, injury and regression risk.

takeaways.label: bust
takeaways.summary: A major knee recovery, limited receiver additions and reduced rushing make separation at quarterback unlikely.

takeaways.label: bust
